integrity: All-length assertions proved by elementary four-block exclusion and exact decimation; finite computation separately reproduces the position-wise radii and sharp maximizers.
limitations: All statements apply only to circular dyadic Thue–Morse blocks at depths at least four and to factors of length at most one circuit. Literature novelty is subject to residual inaccessible-source risk; independent scientific audit was not performed.
title: Exact circular palindrome centers in dyadic Thue–Morse words
